query:
UPDATE characters
        SET user_id = $2, first_name = $3, last_name = $4, class = $5, race = $6, sex = $7,
            is_main = $8, level = COALESCE($9::smallint, level),
            reached_60_at = CASE WHEN COALESCE($9::smallint, level) = 60
                                 THEN COALESCE($10, reached_60_at, now()) END
        WHERE id = $1
